stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Why did the till show NaN?

stations.title: Offers
stations.text: Passed in as functions of any kind.

captions: Imogen asks why a Friday offer at Oakhollow made the till show NaN.
The offer gave back text, and the code took it like any other function.
You write the type of every function passed in: what it takes and gives back.
Now an offer that gives back text is refused, and the tin gets its Friday price.
Offers and label styles are checked functions, and new rules are made to order.
